# My AI Photoshoot

> My AI Photoshoot is an AI photo creation and editing app for portraits and photo transformations using presets, Masks, Studio, and custom prompts.

## Pages

- [Home](https://myaiphotoshoot.com/)
- [Presets](https://myaiphotoshoot.com/presets/)
- [Masks](https://myaiphotoshoot.com/masks/)
- [Studio – Custom AI Photo Creation](https://myaiphotoshoot.com/studio/)
- [Use Cases](https://myaiphotoshoot.com/use-cases/)
- [Blog](https://myaiphotoshoot.com/blog/)
- [Legal](https://myaiphotoshoot.com/legal/)

## Guides

- [AI Headshot Generator](https://myaiphotoshoot.com/use-cases/ai-headshot-generator-for-linkedin-resumes-and-team-pages/): Create headshots for LinkedIn, resumes, and team pages from your photo.
- [AI Dating Profile Picture Generator](https://myaiphotoshoot.com/use-cases/ai-dating-profile-picture-generator/): Create dating profile photos with clothing and settings that reflect your style.
- [AI Avatar Generator](https://myaiphotoshoot.com/use-cases/ai-avatar-generator/): Create illustrated or photographic avatars for social profiles, chat icons, and gaming accounts.
